title: Pal Dot App
style: Latin trap-dembow with clap-driven percussion, rolling trap bass, syncopated dembow bounce, and alt R&B lift; verses ride sparse handclaps and sub pulses, pre-chorus opens with stacked high-octave vocals and filtered gang replies, chorus hits with doubled lead and chanty ad-libs. Ear candy: reversed risers into the drop, glitchy vocal chops, and short delay throws on the hook. Bright, punchy, and glossy with a hot low end., alternative r&b, rap, latin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
nicaragua, sí, aquí estoy
clap en la palma, yo soy
rappal.app, lo oíste bien
rap pal dot app, dame el tren

tú ya sabes, ven, ven, ven
sing it back pal, otra vez
wanna dance pal, suéltate
dance latin america, hey

go to pal dot dance, va
mueve el piso, mira, ya
high vocals, sube la voz
kid comuter voces, los dos

[Pre-Chorus]
be my song pal, quédate
song pal dot a i, ya ves
yo te llamo y tú también
siente el golpe, cae otra vez

[Chorus]
pal rap back, pal rap back
sing it back, pal rap back
pal rap back, pal rap back
dale, dale, pal rap back

songpal.ai, song pal
or sing pal, dime, ya
sing here, sing pal dot a i
sing everwhere, hasta allá

[Verse 2]
trap bass debajo, va al andar
yo lo prendo sin explicar
clap, clap, cae el corazón
y tu boca dice que sí, por favor

nicaragua, no me voy
tú me miras, yo te doy
rappal.app, vuelve a sonar
rap pal dot app, sin parar

[Bridge]
pal, pal, pal, yo te vi
song pal dot a i, así
sube arriba, baja aquí
y repite junto a mí

[Chorus]
pal rap back, pal rap back
sing it back, pal rap back
pal rap back, pal rap back
dale, dale, pal rap back

songpal.ai, song pal
or sing pal, dime, ya
sing here, sing pal dot a i
sing everwhere, hasta allá
